objective: K23 fix F2: opt-in exact per-date exchange-session windows for the CRT session filter and time score. Each session is defined in its own exchange zone (Tokyo 09-18 JST, London 08-17 London time, NY 08-17 NY time) and resolved per bar via the existing NY-DST broker->UTC rule in features.broker_clock. Default is the legacy static broker-time windows, so every existing config is byte-identical.
change_class_rationale: Changes CRTEngine.process_candle's session filter, UltronRiskEngine.score_time and BacktestRunner._session only when backtest.session_window_basis='exchange_local'. Optional backtest-section keys with a legacy default, passed BacktestRunner -> CRTEngine as a constructor argument. Deliberately NOT CRTConfig fields (census pins every field; same reasoning as CH-k23-f3/f4). broker_clock.py gains pure functions only (no change to the existing conversions). No feature math, model, ontology formula or production config edit.

unknowns.item: TOKYO is not in engine_runner.allowed_sessions on any config. Under exchange_local the engine fails closed on an allowed session with no window, but does NOT add TOKYO to admission; a shadow config must add it deliberately.
unknowns.why_non_blocking: Admission is a config decision, out of scope; this change only makes the mechanism exist.

unknowns.item: OVERLAP is allowed in engine_runner.allowed_sessions but no window produces that name in either mode (the legacy filter only matches session_windows keys). It is exempted from the fail-closed check and remains inert; a London/NY overlap resolves to the first-declared session.
unknowns.why_non_blocking: Pre-existing behaviour, preserved and documented; changing it would be a separate economic decision.

unknowns.item: No shadow config sets session_window_basis='exchange_local', so the effect on entries/trades on the real XAUUSD corpus is UNMEASURED.
unknowns.why_non_blocking: Shadow config is the next step (design doc 9.3), separately authorized.

rollback_boundary: Remove the exchange_session_windows constructor argument from CRTEngine/UltronRiskEngine, the BacktestConfig fields/parse/plumbing/stamp, the BacktestRunner._session branch, the broker_clock additions, the test file and this manifest. With the default the behaviour is the pre-change behaviour.
authority_granted: User 2026-09-24: F2 = real exchange hours converted with a US-DST-aware rule (design doc 8c); exact per-date windows chosen in-session over static windows.
authority_NOT_granted: No shadow config created, no ACTIVE_VERSION change, no promotion, no G001, no claim the windows improve anything. Feature `session` labels (FM-052) and session_timestamp_basis are untouched.
